data.action: 围着红围巾，将一只手伸进视角大衣口袋取暖，呼着热气侧首微笑
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, winter romantic walk
data.description: 初雪飘落的宁静公园长椅旁，希耶尔穿着暖和的米色毛衣与风衣，脖子上围着一条红色长围巾。寒风吹红了她小巧的鼻尖，她呵出一口白色的暖气，有些羞怯地将自己冰凉纤细的手指悄悄钻进你的大衣口袋里十指相扣，侧过头露出安心又幸福的笑靥——「呼……手好冷呢。不过，被你握住的话，一下子就变得好暖和了。」
data.lighting: 初雪折射的清冷天光与公园路灯初上
data.location: 初雪落满松树与木长椅的静谧冬日公园
data.promptProse: Ciel wears her beige trench coat and long red scarf as she walks beside her companion, a short, dark-haired man in a charcoal wool coat. Her breath clouds as she slips her cold hand into his coat pocket and their fingers interlace. He turns toward her as park lamps begin to glow by the snowy bench.
data.title: 希耶尔 · 冬日公园的暖袋牵手
data.animaCaption: Ciel, with a blue bob, glasses and a red scarf, slips her hand into the pocket of the man beside her. He has short dark curls and a charcoal wool coat, and turns toward her as their hands meet inside his pocket.
